title: Leverage: debt to net assets and debt to total assets

coverage.note: The panel holds 30 of the 32 calendar quarters in the window: 2019Q3 and 2022Q1 are absent and are shown as breaks; no value is interpolated or bridged across them. Debt is total_debt_outstanding as reported on the balance sheet; it is not adjusted for cash.
